summary: A mixed legal and retail day, anchored by high-court judgments on judicial accountability and a major regulatory reprieve for Reliance's beverage unit. Separately, the DFM Foods auction heats up with five bidders competing for a ₹5,500 crore stake.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court orders criminal complaint against 6 CBI officials for making false statements in case.
Calcutta High Court awards ₹5.36 lakh compensation to man imprisoned 60 days after bail was granted.
FSSAI's ban on Reliance Campa selling beverages as 'energy drinks' put on hold by court.
EQT, Emami, Balaji Wafers join ITC and TPG in ₹5,500 crore race for Advent's 96.63% stake in DFM Foods.
Jio Platforms seeking ₹37,700 crore in IPO with subscriptions to commence October 21.
